concerns.text: Phase 8 – Quickstart Documentation is listed as a project phase but is not linked to any Functional Requirement (FR‑001 – FR‑009) or Success Criterion (SC‑001 – SC‑005) in the specification. This represents an over‑reach in the plan; either associate this documentation effort with a relevant FR/SC (e.g., a documentation requirement) or remove the phase to keep the plan strictly scoped to the spec.
